about_the_game:
“You’re the one holding the gun… But the boss? He rides on your shoulder.”

Explore 14 Unique Maps

  • From eerie forests to abandoned villages, DecayZ Origin features 14 handcrafted maps, each offering its own atmosphere, challenges, and hidden secrets to uncover.

6+ Hours of Gameplay

  • Dive into a gripping survival experience with over 6 hours of content, combining exploration, intense combat, puzzle-solving, and a unique bond with your loyal cat companion.

  • Unlock New Game+ to replay the story with your upgraded gear carried over, offering new challenges and greater rewards.


Game Feature

Story Puzzles

  • Solve environment-based puzzles integrated into the main storyline. These challenges test your logic and observation, unlocking new areas and secrets.

Upgrade Weapon

  • Enhance your gear to increase damage, improve clip size, and unlock special abilities.

Craft Ammo and Health

  • Collect resources to craft various types of ammunition and health items essential for survival.

Map System

  • Use a detailed map to track objectives, mark locations, and explore key areas. The map updates as you discover new zones, making navigation intuitive and strategic.


Quest Guide Line

  • Follow a clear quest guide system that helps you stay on track with main objectives. Waypoints and journal entries keep you informed of your progress and goals.

Prologue

In the remote mountains of Thailand, a top-secret government laboratory becomes ground zero for a deadly virus that spreads with the ferocity of a wildfire. As the virus ravages the surrounding villages, the government imposes martial law, but it's too late. The virus claims thousands of lives in just one week, leaving no hope for a cure or vaccine.

As the infected slowly die and rise again as mutations, the government keeps their disappearance under wraps, and the project is abandoned, forgotten, and left to the virus's mercy.

However, 20 years later, the virus has spread beyond the isolated mountains, and the world is gripped in a pandemic that leaves no hope. The government, desperate for a cure, seeks foreign aid and dispatches a first expedition team to contain the outbreak, but they disappear without a trace. The second expedition team is sent in to find the source of the virus. However, as the team ventures back into the mountains, they realize that the virus has evolved, adapted, and become far more terrifying than anyone ever imagined. What they find there will test their will to survive and may mean the end of humanity as we know it.

name: DecayZ Origin

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 (3.3Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (3.2Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 580 with 8GB VRAM ／ NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 with 6GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 (3.2Ghz) or AMD Ryzen 5 3600 (3.6 Ghz)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: AMD Radeon RX 5700 XT or NVIDIA GeForce GTX GTX 1080 with 8GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 30 GB available space

short_description: DecayZ Origin is a third-person survival shooter set in a world ravaged by a deadly virus. Explore ruins, fight terrifying mutations, solve story-driven puzzles, and survive with your cat companion. free update adds more content.
